KIDS’ WALLPAPER

Tropical Birds and Flowers

A tropical reverie of jewel-toned birds — a teal-and-black perched bird above and a vivid kingfisher-like bird below — nestled among hibiscus, magnolia-like blooms and layered palms in coral-red, cream and dusty sage. The soft botanical style sits on a pale mint-green ground with airy negative space, calm rather than busy. As a continuous mural fitted to your wall, the birds and focal blooms reposition instead of repeating. Delightful in a nursery, kids' room, bedroom or dining nook; place furniture low so the birds stay in view. Soft Matte flatters its gentle painterly washes.
